title: Your Identity In Christ | Who God Says You Are (Stop Letting The World Name You)
description:
Your identity in Christ: who God says you are, straight from Scripture.

People named you a long time ago. This walks through what your Maker says instead: fearfully and wonderfully made, called by name, a child of God, his workmanship, and not finished yet.

"But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine." Isaiah 43:1 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): 1 Samuel 16:7, Psalm 139:13-14, Isaiah 43:1, John 1:12, 1 John 3:1, Ephesians 2:10, 1 Peter 2:9, Jeremiah 29:11, Philippians 1:6.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
